name: STEM Drone Summer Camp
what_you_do: Build a drone that works. Learn to solder. Learn the FAA safety rules. Fly drones with an adult watching. Then study the data from the air with GIS tools.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students who enjoy hands-on learning, per the program page. One camp is for middle and high school students. The other camps listed are for 3rd to 6th graders.
pay_detail: $250 per student. Drone equipment and materials are included.
duration: One week, Monday to Friday. Middle and high school camp dates on the page: July 27-31
deadline_text: The page lists dates but no year and no deadline. Spots are limited.
how_to_apply: Use the sign up link for your camp on the program page. Questions? Email workforcedevelopment@msubillings.edu. Or call 406-896-5965.
notes: The page does not say which year the dates are for. Check before you plan.
